title: Home Caregiving Grant: applicant numbers, age breakdown and eligibility criteria
asked: The MP asked for the cumulative number of Home Caregiving Grant applicants to date, the top three conditions cared for by applicants, and applicant numbers broken down by age band from 30-39 up to 70 and above.
response: Since the HCG started in 2019 there have been over 94,000 cumulative applicants, of whom 74% were aged 70 and above, 15% were 60 to 69, 5% were 50 to 59, 2% were 40 to 49 and 1% were 30 to 39 at the point of application. The Ministry of Health does not collect information on applicants' specific conditions. The scheme is means-tested and structured around recipients being unable to perform the Activities of Daily Living (ADLs); those with autism, intellectual disabilities or mental health conditions who cannot perform ADLs satisfy the requirement, and a doctor's certification of permanent inability to perform daily activities is the basis for eligibility rather than a separate assessment.
